title: When does Qwen3 0.6B commit to its answer?

runtime.captureMethod: nnsight trace of a teacher-forced forward pass over the prompt and generated tokens, after generation

rules.internal: The first step from which the model's final answer is the top digit, under the logit lens restricted to the ten digit tokens, at most layers of the network's second half, at that step and every one after it, through the position before the answer.
rules.stated: The first reasoning step whose text contains the answer as a number on its own (not part of a longer number). A text heuristic.

validation.groundTruth: A 4-layer Qwen3-architecture model with hand-written weights and a 64-token vocabulary. It answers σ(x) = (7x + 3) mod 64 for the last token x. Layer 1 writes x into dimensions the unembedding never reads; layer 2 writes σ(x) into the unembedding's basis.
validation.metric: top-1 accuracy of the decoded token against the planted variable, at the last position
